SAMUEL Sorry, wrong person. Jade raises an eyebrow, turns around and walks into the hotel, while Frank whispers a warning to Samuel. FRANKHer life now has nothing to do with you. Don't bother her anymore. Frank follows Jade into the hotel. Lily stomps her feet unhappily when she sees Samuel looking lost.
INT. HOTEL LOUNGE - DAY109 109

Jade closed her compact. JADE (OS)No matter what, Samuel has his new life now, and I have your own life too. I mustn't Look back. Jade packs up her things and turns to go out, but Samuel pushes the door open. JADE(cont'd)(calm)Sir, this is my lounge, you must have the wrong place. SAMUELNo, I've come to see you. JADEBut we don't know each other, sir. As Jade starts to walk out Samuel grabs her wrist. SAMUELI know it's you. When I was hospitalized a year ago, you came to see me in the ward. I know your face. Jade takes a deep breath and turns to look at Samuel. JADESamuel, there are so many people in this world who look alike. Must you question every one of them? Samuel tightens his grip.
James pushes open the door of the lounge, see Samuel, frowns, and pulls Jade over. JAMES Samuel, what are you doing? SAMUEL Who are you? Jade tugs on James' hand. 102
output.speaker: SAMUEL I...

output.text: JAMES I'm Jade's boyfriend, James.
INT. HOTEL LOUNGE - DAY110 110

James holds Jade's hand and looks at Samuel. JAMES I'm Jade's boyfriend, James. SAMUEL You... have a boyfriend? Samuel clutches his chest and Jade frowns. SAMUEL (OS)(cont'd)Why...why does that make you feel sad? James steps in front of Jade to block Samuel's view. JAMESMr. Fisher, you can not leave your fiancée to come and harass my girlfriend. If you don't leave, I will Call the police! Samuel SIGHS. SAMUELPlease accept my apologies. Samuel walks out, Jade sobs into her hands. JAMESJade, I'm sorry, I just took the liberty of saying I was your boyfriend. JADEIt's okay, I know you just wanted him to leave. JAMESYou know, we have been together for a year and I think you might reconsider our relationship. JADE (wiping tears)James, let's get married… 103

JAMESAre you serious? I've been waiting for this day for a long time! Jade looks at James and nods. JADEJames, I'm a little tired now. Please leave me for a while. James walks out slowly closes the door, almost all the way.

output.character: INT. AT THE DOOR OF HOTEL LOUNGE - DAY110A 110A
output.text: Through the crack of the door, James sees Jade kneeling on the ground, crying. JAMES (OS) Jade, do you really love me? James closes the door, looks at Samuel's back who stands with Lily not far away, and clenches his fists. JAMES (OS)(cont'd)Samuel, I won't let you take her away from me this time...
INT. HOTEL BANQUET HALL - DAY111 111

The guests move around freely. Samuel's eyes occasionally glance at Jade, who toasts not far away. LILY(unhappy)Samuel, you are my fiancé, why are you always looking at other girls? Samuel comes back to his senses. SAMUELShe just looks familiar, don't think too much about it. KEVIN (V.O.)Hello, everybody! Everyone looks at Kevin who was stands on the stage, and REPORTERS swarm around. 104

KEVINI am very happy to attend this banquet of top families as an invited guest of the Carey family. As everyone knows, Jade, the daughter of the Carey family, is my only student. She has also become a top designer in the world fashion within a year. Her designs have won many awards. Jade holds her wine glass and looks at Kevin on the stage with a smile. KEVIN(cont'd) Jade, come up. Jade hands her glass to James and walks up to the stage slowly. KEVIN(cont'd)From today on, Jade will focus on building her own luxury brand: Jade. We welcome all of you to come to us to design custom apparel. The whole audience APPLAUDS and Lily stamps her feet unhappily. LILYWho is the star of today after all? She's really good at stealing the limelight! SAMUELDon't say such things that would lower your reputation. LILYSamuel! SAMUEL (OS)I really can't fall in love with such a vulgar woman. Samuel suddenly notices a woman holding a iron bar next to James. SAMUEL (OS)(cont'd)Who is she... Why have I never seen her before? Helen quickens her steps holding the iron bar, and Samuel looks at her direction - It is towards Jade. 105

SAMUEL(cont'd)Jade! Helen rushes straight towards Jade on the stage, and Kevin and Jade's eyes widened instantly. KEVINHelen! Helen raises the iron bar and swings it at Jade. Jade closes her eyes and only hears a dull sound. LILY (V.O.)Samuel! Jade's eyes snap open to see Samuel standing in front of her, blood pouring from his head. JADE Samuel! SAMUEL(weakly)Didn't I protect you like this before? Samuel collapses to the floor.
INT. HOTEL BANQUET HALL - DAY112 112

Helen raises the pipe and swings it at Jade. Jade closes her eyes. Samuel steps in front of Jade and gets hit him hard with the stick. LILY (O.S.)Samuel! Jade's eyes snap open to see Samuel standing in front of her, blood pouring from his head. JADE Samuel! SAMUEL (weakly)Didn't I protect you like this before? Samuel faints on the ground and Jade quickly hugs him. Helen realizes something is wrong and tries to run away, but is stops by James. She turns around and sees Kevin again. 106
KEVINHelen, why did you do that? You're going to prison! HELENIt's all her fault. She destroyed everything I've had for so many years! It's all her fault! Jade steps forward and slaps Helen hard.
INT. HOTEL BANQUET HALL - DAY113 113

Jade steps forward and slaps Helen hard. JADE Helen, I'm warning you, if anything happens to Samuel, I'll make you beg for death in jail. HELEN (laughing)Kevin, James, you see, the woman you are protecting has another man in her heart. Such a love story, hahahaha! Helen is dragged away by the security guards. Jade clenches her fists and turns to looks at Samuel who is being carried on a stretcher. Just as she is about to follow him, James pulls her away. JAMESJade, if you follow him, you'll never be able to start over again... Jade pauses and Lily glares at her. LILYJade! I don't care what your relationship with Samuel is. We're getting married, stay away from him! After that, Lily runs after Samuel's stretcher. Jade's tears fall. James and Kevin reach out to comfort her. Jade waves her hand, steps off the stage and walks towards Frank. JADEDad, I want to go home. 107

FRANKJade, you really need some rest. JADEDad... why did Samuel stand in front of me? FRANKI don't know. Judging from what happened today, it seems that he did not remember who you were. JADELove never forgets... Frank looks at Jade. JADE(cont'd)Take me to the hospital.
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY114 114

Samuel lies on the hospital bed with blood covering is head. His eyes are blurry, he clutches his head, groaning in pain. LILYSamuel, don't touch yourself, you're covered in blood! Samuel stares at the bright hospital ceiling, his expression dazed, and holds Lily's hand. Jade stands at the ward door and watches Samuel hold Lily's hand tightly. She stops in her tracks. JADE (OS)Jade, what are you doing... You are no longer the same person, and you shouldn't be the one staying with him now.... Jade turns back reluctantly. Samuel murmurs something, Lily leans in closer. To Jade, they seem so intimate. JADE (OS)(cont'd)Samuel, you and your future wife are in love... I feel relieved... Jade turns and leaves. LILY Samuel, I can't hear you. 108
SAMUEL Jade, I'm sorry… Samuel closes his eyes as he speaks. LILY(whispering) Whose name are you in? Jade? A fierce look flashes in Lily's eyes.
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY115 115

Samuel lies on the hospital bed. He frowns as if he was dreaming and suddenly wakes up. SAMUELJade! Samuel sits up, panting, and Mary holds his hand. MARYSamuel, what's wrong? Are you having a nightmare? SAMUELMom, Jade is my ex-wife, right? Mary's hand stiffens. MARYSamuel... SAMUELMom, what is going on between Jade and me? Why are you hiding it from me? Mary sighs. MARYSamuel, do you really want to know, even if it hurts you... SAMUELI want to know. I clearly feel that I love her now, but I can't remember everything. This makes everything feel more painful. Mary purses her lips and looks up at Samuel. 109

MARYJade is your ex-wife. She was the adopted daughter of the Garrison family, and was actually the kidnapped lost daughter of the Carey family. SAMUELShe used to be my wife? So why is she pretending not to know me? Mary sighs and glances at Samuel. MARYSamuel, we Fishers owe her all these years... SAMUELWhat do you mean? MARY Jade hasn't had a good day since she married you. You and I both think she stole the Garrison family's biological daughter, Olivia's position...(chokes up)And humiliate her... SAMUELWhat... But I can clearly feel it. I love her very much. When I see her, I can't help wanting to get close to her... How could I hurt her like this? Samuel stares at Mary in panic, and Mary holds his hand. MARYBack then, Olivia fooled us all. She kept framing Jade, twisting everything against her. And yet, she had the audacity to pretend she saved your life—making us all believe her lies. SAMUELWho's the kid in that photo... MARYIt's your son.(sighs)Back then, Jade told me she was pregnant.
But I did not believe it was yours. And Jade left home in desperation, wandering for five years... Samuel's eyes widen and he grabs the quilt helplessly. SAMUELFive years?!
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY116 116

Samuel grabs the blanket like a child who has done something wrong. SAMUELFive years?! MARYFive years later, she came back with a child. You think the child was born of her and another man. To punish Jade, you made her a maid and nanny during the day and a prostitute in your nightclub at night. Samuel's eyes widen and covers his head in pain. Mary hugs him in panic. SAMUELHow could I do that to her! MARYActually, you and Jade have always loved each other, but you have been torturing each other for too long. SAMUELI tortured her, and she has been suffering all this time... MARYSamuel, are you still going to go find her? SAMUEL(shaking his head)No, she already has a new identity and a new life.

Since she pretends not to know me, then she wants to deny our past. I won't bother her anymore. MARYBut... Samuel, this may not be... up to you... SAMUELWhat do you mean? MARYOur company's new fashion project partner invited Jade to design the formal attire... Jade will tailor clothes for you in a couple of days. The light shines in Samuel's eyes. SAMUEL (OS) I can still see her...
INT. FISHER'S OFFICE - DAY117 117

SAMUELYou're here. JADESamuel, take off your coat. I'll measure for your clothes and leave. Samuel says nothing, but takes off his coat. Jade sets out her tool box, takes out a measuring tape, and measures Samuel. When Jade puts her arm around Samuel's waist to measure it, Samuel can't help but hug her. SAMUELJade... JADEI am no longer the Jade I used to be! SAMUELOkay. I remember all about our past now. You can also feel that I love you. Love does not disappear even if I lose my memory...

JADEPlease don't dwell on the past. Samuel, we'll only hurt each other if we're together. What's more, I already have someone I want to entrust the rest of my life too. Samuel's eyes turn red, and he puts his hand on Jade's face and kisses her. Jade opens her eyes wide and pushes Samuel away. JADE(cont'd)Samuel! Are you crazy? SAMUEL (ROARING)Yes, I am crazy. I understand what you said, but I am unwilling to do it! I really love you, and I also wont forget you. I also told myself not to bother, but I can't do it...Jade, I beg you, if you are angry with me, you can punish me however you want, but please don't be with another. JADE (trembling)Samuel, you already have a new partner, and I have started a new life. Since you bullied me so horribly, there is no possibility of us being together again. Do you understand? Samuel slumps in his chair, holding his head. SAMUEL (crying)You're still blaming me... Jade puts away her measuring tape. JADEI have roughly measured the size, and I will ask someone to deliver your clothes on time. With that, Jade straightens her clothes, takes the box and leaves. Samuel shouts and sweeps the things off the table. 113
INT. HOTEL BANQUET HALL - DAY119 119

Frank, Summer and James' parents stand on the stage, smiling at the guests. FRANKWelcome everyone to the engagement party of my daughter Jade and her fiancé James. Please give a round of applause to welcome them on stage! James walks onto the stage smiling, holding Jade's arm, while Jade holds the microphone. JADEJames and I have known each other for a few years, and he has taken care of me without asking for anything in return. He is the kindest and most sincere person in the world. I want to give the rest of my life to him. 114
LILY (V.O.) Are you worthy? Everyone looks towards the hotel entrance. Lily pushes the door open with a bunch of REPORTERS, looking at Jade with a sneer.
INT. HOTEL BANQUET HALL - DAY121 121

Lily sneers at the people present with a bunch of reporters, and Kevin stands up. KEVINMiss Lily, what do you mean barging in uninvited and bringing so many reporters here? LILYOh, Carey family's daughter's engagement is definitely worth celebrating by the whole town. KEVIN Would you be so kind? LILY (laughing)Not only am I kind, I also brought a gift for Jade. 115

Lily waves, and her Assistant runs backstage with the USB. LILY(cont'd)How can an engagement party be complete without the couple's personal profiles? The big screen on the stage suddenly starts playing a clip of Jade working in the nightclub. The reporters begin filming frantically. The microphone falls to the ground and make a buzzing sound. JAMES(shouting)Stop filming! Stop filming! Frank holds his heart and is supported by Summer. James protects Jade. Kevin rushes forward in front of the reporters' cameras. Jade's ears gradually lose the sound of the crowd. She stares at the screen, motionless, at her clothes being torn off by a man. The sight of money stuffed into the collar makes her laugh out loud.
INT. HOTEL BANQUET HALL - DAY122 122

Jade LAUGHS SO HARD on the stage. Everyone looks at her and falls silent. At this moment, Samuel and Mike arrive. LILY Jade, how can you still laugh? Mike sees the scene on the big screen and wants to rush over but is stopped by Samuel. SAMUEL Trust her and listen to her. Jade bends down to pick up the microphone and looks at the reporter's cameras. JADEI'm sorry to spoil your fantasy. Yes, before I returned to my current identity, I was an adopted daughter and also the ex-wife of the president of Fisher's Group, Samuel. The guests looks at each other. 116

JADE(cont'd)Because I was an adopted daughter, I had to leave the house and suffer humiliation when the biological daughter came back. And I have to pay off the debt I owed to my ex-husband... SAMUEL (whispering)No, you don't owe me, you don't owe me... JADESo I went to work at his nightclub to earn money. There is an UPROAR at the scene. JADE(cont'd)But that was my job, I always followed my rules: selling the wines, not myself. I don't think it's anything to be ashamed of, even though I'm a different person now, I still want to be honest with the past. Jade's tears flow down, and Summer and James cry bitterly beside her.
INT. HOTEL BANQUET HALL - DAY123 123

Jade looks into the camera with tears in her eyes. JADEEven though I am a different person now, I still want to say to my past self… Thank you for your hard work, Jade… The whole hall is silent. Kevin, Mike and others all have tears in their eyes. The Reporters put down their cameras and someone shouts something. GUEST Isn't that Samuel at the door? Everyone looks towards the door and Samuel, shaking all over, rushes in and grabbed Lily's arm. 117

SAMUELAre you satisfied? Have you had enough trouble? Stop embarrassing yourself here! Get out of here with all your people! The Reporters turn their cameras and take pictures of Samuel and Lily. LILYSamuel, I'm your fiancée, how dare you say such harsh words to me! SAMUELNot anymore. LILYSamuel, do you know what you are talking about? Samuel turns and looks at Jade. SAMUELI'm sorry for the pain I've caused you, Jade. I hope you and James have a happy marriage. (To the guest)I also want to make an announcement, from now on, Fisher and the Lily's engagement is cancelled! Samuel bows deeply to Jade and strides away, leaving Lily with tears in her eyes. LILY Stop filming! Get out of here! Lily runs out, followed by the Reporters. Jade slumps to the ground.
INT. HOTEL HALLWAY - DAY124 124
James paces through the hotel banquet hall, looking at his watch. JAMES (OS)It's been so long, why hasn't Jade arrived? 118

James calls Jade, but the phone is turned off. James then calls Kevin. JAMES(cont'd)Kevin, has Jade left her office? KEVIN(O.V.)She left a long time ago. Aren't you having dinner with both sets of parents today? JAMESBut Jade hasn't arrived yet. I feel like something's happened to her. KEVINHang on, I'll ask someone to check the surveillance camera at the entrance of the magazine office. James hangs up the phone and bites his nails. JAMES (OS) I should have picked her up... The phone RINGS and James picks up immediately. KEVIN (V.O.)James! Jade was kidnapped! JAMES What?!
INT. ABANDONED FACTORY - DAY126 126

Jade is tied to a chair in an abandoned warehouse, the sack on her head is removed, and the sudden light causes blur in her eyes. JADELily... Lily sits on the chair opposite, with a GROUP OF GANGSTERS standing behind her. She looks at Jade with a smile. LILYJade, take a guess—will you die first, or will Samuel get here in time? JADELily! You're crazy! If you kill me, the Carey family will bury all of your family with you! Lily nods, grinning. LILYI changed my mind. I want both you and Samuel to die!
INT. ABANDONED FACTORY - DAY127 127

Lily smiles and looks at Jade. LILYI changed my mind. I want both you and Samuel to die! JADEWhy do you hate me so much? LILY (gritting her teeth)Why? It's because you are Samuel's ex-wife, and he only has you in his heart. Because of you, Samuel broke off our engagement, and I will be mocked by the whole world. Jade sneers. 120

JADEIt was you who tried to humiliate me at my engagement party. How can you blame me? Lily stands up suddenly and slaps Jade angrily. LILYShut up! Without you! I would still be a big star. I would still marry the best man in the world. Because of you, I have nothing! Jade spits. JADELily, you know, you look really pitiful right now. Lily yells in anger. LILYBeat her! Beat her until she can't say a word! Beat her! Two Gangsters rush forward, and Jade stares at Lily while being beaten. After a while, Lily raise her hands. LILY(cont'd) Stop. The gangsters stop and Lily grabs Jade's chin. LILY(cont'd)Jade, if you beg for mercy now, you might still be able to live. Jade spits at Lily and shakes her off. LILY(cont'd)I'm tired of watching you guys beat her, just enjoy yourself. The 2 Gangsters laugh. Jade's clothes are torn off. Suddenly the door opens, and Samuel stands in the backlight.
INT. ABANDONED FACTORY - DAY128 128
EXT. OUTSIDE THE ABANDONED FACTORY - DAY129
Jade's clothes are torn off by the gangsters. 121
Samuel carries Jade out of the abandoned factory and runs into James and Kevin who are getting out of the car in a hurry.

JADE (horrified)Don't touch me! Don't touch me! LILY(laughing wildly) Make sure she can't even scream! The gangsters to pull at Jade's clothes. JADE Stop! Let me go! Samuel kicks open the door and stands in the backlight. JADE (cont'd)(crying)Samuel, save me! Samuel rushes forward with Mike and 2 BODYGUARDS in black. The Gangsters are shocked by them. LILY(panicked)Don't be afraid of them. If you kill this man, I'll give everyone double the money! The Gangsters look at each other and rush forward fiercely. Mike and 2 Bodyguards wrestle with them. Samuel kicks two Gangsters, then rushes to Jade, takes off his coat and covers her with it. SAMUELDon't be afraid, Jade. I'm here. JADESamuel, be careful! Samuel's eyes turn red and he turns around to fight with gangsters. After a while, the gangsters fall to the ground and can't get up. Samuel and Mike are both injured. Samuel turns around and sees Jade faint. Samuel carries Jade passing by Lily, who is so scared and sits down on the chair. SAMUELMike, drag this bitch to my nightclub and make her free to all the men. 122
MIKEYes, boss. The Bodyguards in black rushes forward and drag Lily away. LILY (screaming)No, no!
EXT. OUTSIDE THE ABANDONED FACTORY - DAY130

Samuel walks out of the abandoned factory holding Jade, and runs into James and Kevin who are getting out of the car in a hurry. James looks at Samuel carrying Jade and clenches his fists. JAMESWho did this? SAMUELLily. KEVINDamn it, Samuel. Control your woman! Mike frowns and steps forward. MIKELet's not talk about the fact that Samuel and Lily are no longer together. Samuel just saved Jade's life at the risk of his own life. Be grateful. Samuel stops Mike and James stops Kevin. SAMUELKevin is right to scold me, this is all my fault. Samuel carries Jade towards James' car. 123

SAMUEL(cont'd)Open the door. Kevin opens the car door and Samuel puts Jade in before walking towards James. SAMUEL(cont'd)(To James)Go on, take her to the hospital and take good care of her. JAMESYou saved her life, so why don't you take her? SAMUELI no longer have any reason to take her anywhere. After saying that, Samuel turns around and leaves with Mike and others. James looks at his back. JAMES (OS)Jade, he loves you more than I thought...
INT. WEDDING - DAY131 131

The wedding is about to begin, and guests are entering the venue. Samuel and Mike sit in the corner of the last row. James stands on the stage and looks at the guests. MCNow please lets welcome the bride and her father to enter! The music starts, and Jade walks slowly towards James holding Frank's arm. Samuel looks at her and tears fall. SAMUEL (whispering)Jade... Jade walks past the GUEST seats and stands in front of James. Frank hands Jade's hand to James. Samuel's fists clench and tears stream down his face. 124

MCAs you can see, the rings in my hand are complete circles, representing the endless eternity.When you exchange rings, your marriage will be forever happy and fulfilled. Samuel stands up, covers his face and cries, and is about to walk out of the wedding venue. MC(cont'd)Now I would like to ask the groom... JAMES Wait, I'm not the groom. Samuel stops and the whole audience is in an UPROAR. Samuel turns around and sees James standing on the stage looking at him. JAMES(cont'd)Samuel, the love vow will be made by you.
INT. WEDDING - DAY132 132

Samuel stands in the corner and looks at James on the stage. JAMESSamuel, the love vow will be made by you. Jade frantically tugs at the corner of James's clothes. JADEJames, you don't have to do this. JAMES (smiling)Samuel, aren't you coming over? Samuel rushes over and grabs James by the collar. SAMUELWhat are you doing? Don't you want to marry her? Are you trying to sabotage your own wedding now? 125

JAMES(bitter smile)I want to marry her, and I love her dearly. But because I love her, I can feel that the person she loves is not me... JADE James... Samuel's hands loosen and he looks at James in disbelief. JAMESJade, follow your heart. That's the best way. You will be truly happy only if you marry the one you love... Jade's tears fall. James looks at Samuel and puts Jade's hand in Samuel's hand. JAMES(cont'd) Don't make her cry again. After that, James takes off the groom's boutonniere on his suit and pins it on Samuel's chest, then walks down the stage. Looking at Jade in front of him, Jade looks at Samuel, and Mike quickly pats the MC. MIKEWhat are you standing there for? Keep going! MCNow, let me ask the groom... SAMUELI do. The MC blinks and looks at Jade. MCBride, are you willing to marry the groom next to you as your only and eternal husband? No matter rich or poor, forever? Jade looks at James who is standing in the distance. James nods at her and turns away. Jade turns her gaze back to Samuel. 126

JADESamuel, do you know what is forever? SAMUELI know. Samuel kisses Jade and Charlie runs up the stage. CHARLIEThe bad guy, I found you. Samuel puts the ring on Jade's finger and picks up Charlie. The three of them hugs each other. -End- 127
